title: Mark all open containers unresolved for template actions instead of popping by column
context: Template action lines (`{{ }}`) have no structural indentation meaning—`{{-` chomps leading space, and `| indent N` requires column 0 while injecting at depth N. The scanner was incorrectly using the action's column to pop the frame stack like a normal YAML line, causing column-0 actions to destroy every open frame and reparent all subsequent lines to root, losing all field-path tracking. Touches invariant(s): con_039cee7367 (Memory hygiene is the agent's job, done without waiting for the human: accept shipped roadmap proposals, settle provenance-repair escalations (apply the true commit or drop), re-anchor or stale findings, and land the resulting capture commits through a PR. Only decisions that need genuine product judgment are queued for the human.).
decision: Introduced `markAllOpenContainersUnresolved()`: template actions now conservatively taint every currently-open container (root through innermost) instead of attempting to determine which ancestor the injection targets. Bare template lines no longer touch the real frame stack at all.
consequences: Fixes stack annihilation bug where column-0 conditionals inside selectors left incomplete maps reading as fully literal, permissive ones
Fixes silent ConfigMap/Secret reference loss after template conditionals
Trades false negatives (over-marking containers as unresolved) for correctness—no more invisible destruction of field-paths
Conservative approach is justified: there is no way to know statically which ancestor a template injection targets
alternatives_rejected: Continue inferring target container from action column position (source of original bugs)
Attempt to parse Helm syntax to determine intended injection depth (too fragile, not maintainable)
